q: The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

s: LORD is everlasting (from long ago)
q: You are from everlasting.

s: LORD is mighty (above the voices of many waters and the breakers of the sea)
q: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

s: LORD has throne throne (established from long ago)
q: Your throne is established from long ago.

s: LORD has statutes statutes (stand firm)
q: Your statutes stand firm.

s: LORD has house house (adorned with holiness forever)
q: Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

s: LORD is a God to whom vengeance belongs
q: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

s: LORD helps the psalmist
q: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

s: LORD holds up the psalmist (through loving kindness)
q: Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

s: the wicked disposition arrogant (pour out arrogant words and boast)
q: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

s: the wicked afflict my people (God's people)
q: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

s: the wicked kill widow
q: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

s: the wicked kill alien
q: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

s: the wicked murder fatherless
q: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

s: the wicked believe the LORD will not see
q: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

s: the wicked have throne of wickedness (brings about mischief by statute)
q: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

s: the wicked condemn the righteous (innocent blood)
q: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

s: LORD is a judge of the earth
q: Rise up, you judge of the earth.

s: the wicked face cutting off by the LORD (for their own wickedness)
q: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness.

s: the wicked face the pit (to be dug for them)
q: until the pit is dug for the wicked.

s: my people (God's people) is a heritage of the LORD
q: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

s: the psalmist relies on LORD (as help)
q: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

s: the psalmist is comforted by LORD (delights in his comforts)
q: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

s: vengeance and judgment belongs to LORD (vengeance)
q: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

s: vengeance and judgment will return to righteousness (judgment)
q: For judgment will return to righteousness.

s: righteous people (the LORD's saints) follow judgment (will follow it)
q: All the upright in heart shall follow it.

s: law (the LORD's law) teaches the man the LORD disciplines (blessed)
q: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

s: LORD knows thoughts of man (that they are futile)
q: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
